summary: ESLint config runs obfuscated payload under downloaded Bun runtime at install time
details: The package advertises itself as an ESLint TypeScript/NestJS configuration but its package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is an obfuscated launcher (hex-named identifiers _0x488df8, _0x52943e, wrapper indirection objects) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<platform>.zip to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB @bun-cjs blob consisting of a rotated string-array cipher (WV8StW / n7gIxM constant table), dense hex identifiers, and multiple `with` statements for parser evasion — bearing no relation to an ESLint configuration. Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node bypasses Node-based install-time instrumentation. Running `npm install` on this package results in arbitrary attacker-controlled code executing on the installer's machine under a runtime the installer did not choose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
